versions.changelog:
- Added a structured YAML frontmatter section describing the skill, its capabilities, and a Chinese summary.
- Improved the overall skill description with a focus on use cases for remixing, resizing, and audience segmentation.
- No changes to functionality or feature set; documentation only.

- Added a new README.md file.
- Updated SKILL.md with a new upgrade link (https://mediaclawbot.com).

- Initial release of Video Repurpose skill.
- Automatically transforms a single video into multiple, platform-optimized variants for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin.
- Features intelligent aspect ratio conversion, multiple hooks, caption restyling, color and speed variation, and voiceover localization.
- Includes a 6-layer deduplication system to ensure each variant is unique for platform algorithms.
- Supports batch repurposing and API access via mediaclaw.ai.
